verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference API provider, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The pack documents only an adjacent privacy posture (private by default, zero data retention, no training on your data), not a user-facing opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking, and the console explicitly manages usage. missing for 10: a documented telemetry opt-out control, a documented usage-tracking opt-out, and any explanation of what telemetry is collected.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Private by default, zero data retention. No training on your data.
